test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"He wrote the letter."

options.text: The letter was written by him.
The letter is written by him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He wrote the letter."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the letter" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "wrote" to "was written" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The letter was written by him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The letter is written by him." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3:** "The letter wrote by him." – Grammatically incorrect (verb form error).
 
• **Option 4:** "The letter had been wrote." – Incorrect verb form (past perfect passive).
